blocks.text: Kiray Celis has ended her partnership with a beauty and wellness business as she prepares to embrace motherhood, its owner announced. Entrepreneur Wiji Esguerra-Ragasa confirmed the development during a press conference on Sunday, Nov. 8, expressing her gratitude to the actress for being part of the company’s journey and respecting her decision to step away. “As she enters an important chapter in her personal life, I fully respect her decision not to continue our partnership. I wish her a beautiful journey into motherhood, continuous success, and good health,” Esguerra-Ragasa said. Celis, who is expecting her first child with husband Stephan Estopia, […]...
